name: Quick Healthy Breakfasts
equipment: A blender or toaster, and basic pantry staples
instructions: Keep 2-3 go-to breakfasts on rotation so you are never deciding from scratch on a busy morning.
Favor whole foods (oats, eggs, fruit, nuts) over packaged "breakfast bars," which are often mostly refined sugar.
Batch a base (a jar of overnight oats, a tray of egg muffins) on the weekend to cut morning prep to under 5 minutes.
Watch today's video for five more quick, healthy breakfast ideas.
